author: KEXP
description: London-based visionary @Obongjayar delivered an irresistible, prismatic fusion of art-pop, alt-R&B, Afrobeats, and synth-pop on his latest record 'Paradise Now'. In a captivating Live on KEXP performance from Trans Musicales, he entrances audience with a live version of "SweetDanger" and more.
title: Obongjayar performs "Sweet Danger" & more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Obongjayar performing live at ESMA in Rennes, France, during Trans Musicales 2025. Recorded December 04, 2025. 

Songs:
Sweet Danger 00:09
Lipdance 03:57
Holy Mountain 07:38
Jellyfish 11:24

OB - Vocals
Ciaran Corr - Guitar
Mutale Chashi - Bass
Elias Atkinson - Trumpet
Oscar Ogden - Drums
